brief: Choose a secure way to retain financial records without exposing access credentials.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Keep useful records private"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Conserva registros útiles y privados"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Guarde registros úteis e privados"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Choose a secure way to retain financial records without exposing access credentials.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Save what you need for follow-up without exposing account access.
instruction.misconception: Treating convenience as sufficient protection or keeping passwords and security codes inside shared financial records.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Keep receipts and statements in protected storage. Passwords and security codes do not belong in a shared record of payments.
The record should remain retrievable while access stays limited.
A shared spending record does not require account credentials.
Relevant details can support a report without public exposure.
A protected backup can preserve records if the device is lost.
Retention depends on the actual record and applicable requirements.
Proof of a shared expense does not require an access secret.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
